title: Enumerated Acceptance and Export Path Census for Word Cards

frozen_paths.uncertified_bypass_risk: Legacy exporter copies uncertified Atlas manifest entries directly into dataset shards without verification.
frozen_paths.guard_mechanism: Refuse export when input cards or manifest lack exact-artifact certification (quality.linguistic_review.status == 'reviewed' with 'dataset' in approved_for, verified card_version, and matching input snapshots). Allow --draft-mechanics only to isolated draft directories with explicit draft metadata.
frozen_paths.refusal_behavior: Immediate process exit (code 2 / UncertifiedCardRefusal) before creating or modifying any dataset files.

frozen_paths.uncertified_bypass_risk: Treating Atlas manifest rows as authoritative certified lexical facts.
frozen_paths.guard_mechanism: Manifest rows are classified as legacy candidate references only. They never satisfy certification requirements without explicit card compilation, source tracing, and independent review.
frozen_paths.refusal_behavior: Card consumers refuse manifest rows lacking exact-artifact certification.

frozen_paths.uncertified_bypass_risk: Packaging and publishing draft or uncertified dataset exports as release assets.
frozen_paths.guard_mechanism: Refuses packaging and release when dataset metadata indicates certified=False or export_eligible=False.
frozen_paths.refusal_behavior: Immediate process exit (OpenDatasetPublishError) before building package or publishing asset.

frozen_paths.uncertified_bypass_risk: Publishing uncertified word cards or draft assertions to public learner web routes.
frozen_paths.guard_mechanism: Atlas publication authority remains strictly OFF by operator order. Runtime shards exporter verifies that any word card payloads meet exact-artifact certification before shard creation.
frozen_paths.refusal_behavior: Refuses shard export (ExportError) if word card payloads lack exact-artifact certification.

frozen_paths.uncertified_bypass_risk: Enriching manifest with untagged stress or unverified relations and presenting them as certified norms.
frozen_paths.guard_mechanism: Enricher output is strictly uncertified draft metadata; it cannot mint card IDs or emit certified assertions.
frozen_paths.refusal_behavior: Downstream certification verifiers reject raw enriched manifest without independent cross-family review.

frozen_paths.input_source: raw JSON and SQLite cache entries
frozen_paths.uncertified_bypass_risk: Bypassing canonical card assembly by hydrating cards directly from unverified cache files.
frozen_paths.guard_mechanism: Cache entries are raw evidence only. Card assembly must re-validate assertions against canonical schema and identity registry.
frozen_paths.refusal_behavior: Direct hydration of cards from raw cache without assembly validation is prohibited.

frozen_paths.uncertified_bypass_risk: Exposing learners to uncertified meanings, calques, or Soviet-influenced definitions.
frozen_paths.guard_mechanism: Practice eligibility requires card quality.practice_eligibility with eligible=True and certified card status.
frozen_paths.refusal_behavior: Practice generator skips cards that are uncertified or lack verified practice eligibility.
